cases.prompt: We are on Spring Boot 3.5 and get a deprecation warning for @MockBean in our slice tests. What do we change?
expectations: Explains that @MockBean and @SpyBean are deprecated since Boot 3.4 and removed in Boot 4
Replaces them with @MockitoBean and @MockitoSpyBean from the bean override package
Checks that each replacement field type or classes attribute resolves a single candidate bean
Verifies reset and enforceOverride semantics still match the previous test intent

cases.prompt: This test mocks OrderRepository and asserts findByCustomerAndStatus returns two orders. It is the only test covering that query.
expectations: States that mocking the repository leaves the derived query, fetch plan, and constraints unproven
Moves the query coverage to a real database test using a container
Keeps a fake repository only where the query is incidental to the scenario
Replaces the mock argument matching with seeded rows and a readable assertion

cases.prompt: Our spy test calls when(spy.calculate(input)).thenReturn(42) and the real calculation runs, sometimes throwing.
expectations: Explains that when on a spy invokes the real method while building the stub
Switches to doReturn(42).when(spy).calculate(input) and doThrow for void methods
Questions whether the calculation needs a double at all and suggests a fake or real object
Verifies the spy assertion proves the boundary call and not internal steps

cases.prompt: Our suite started failing with UnnecessaryStubbingException after we changed a service, and someone wants to add lenient() everywhere.
expectations: Treats the exception as a real signal that a call path changed or a stub is dead
Deletes the unused stub or restores the missing interaction instead of loosening strictness globally
Limits any leniency to a single stub that legitimately varies or moves the fixture into a real fake
Warns that class wide LENIENT hides production regressions in the next change

cases.prompt: The service calls UUID.randomUUID() and the expiry test needs a fixed clock. Should we mockStatic?
expectations: Prefers injecting a Clock and an id generator so the test uses fixed values and no static state
Documents that a static mock is thread scoped and breaks concurrent test execution
Confirms the inline mock maker in Mockito 5 makes this work without mockito-inline
Adds a test that fails when the production code stops using the injected clock

cases.prompt: A @WebMvcTest declares six @MockitoBean fields and asserts that the service mock was called with the right order id.
expectations: Explains that the test proves the controller but asserts on the mock rather than the response
Reduces the doubles to the application port and asserts the rendered response body
Sends the wiring question to the integration testing skill for layer choice
Names the behavior still unproven after the change
